profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Programming language lover; software engineer working on TypeScript at Microsoft.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on the TypeScript team!

Previously working on the Python team:
- https://github.com/microsoft/pylance-release
- https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-python

positions.title: SWE Intern
positions.description:
- Extended an Azure SRE chat bot to include Universal Store data
- Added plugins to answer questions about live incidents and assets without dashboards, email, or SQL queries
- Demoed bot its features to leadership and planned future improvements

positions.title: SRE Intern
positions.description:
- Wrote validators in Go to check Ads Frontend jobs for standards conformity
- Separated generalized validator features out into the main validator contrib library set and refactored existing validator code
- Implemented a multi-language task configuration fingerprinting library in Go, Python, and Java
- Tested fingerprinting on multiple live services and troubleshooted production issues

positions.title: SDE Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a plugin in Go for high performance data ingestion, and benchmarked it against various log stream tests
- Halved CPU usage compared to the existing supported agent, given the same ingestion rates and stream count
- Developed infrastructure for platform and integration testing on small computing devices such as the Raspberry Pi
- Demoed to the Monitoring teams using the Go code on a Raspberry Pi and triggering notifications on GPIO events

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Created a patent examiner directory to visualize static examiner data using Flask and Chart.js
- Benchmarked NoSQL document stores (MongoDB and RethinkDB) with patent data
- Implemented natural language processing algorithms to classify patent applications
